summary: SemVer 2.0.0 validation and precedence, including pre-release edge cases
instruction: Implement `is_valid(version)` and `compare(a, b)` in semver.py following the Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 spec exactly (semver.org): validation of the full grammar, and precedence (compare returns -1, 0 or 1; raise ValueError for invalid input). No leading `v`, no third-party packages. test_semver.py has a few starter tests (`python3 -m unittest`).
